 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 80
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
 BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
 BackgroundColor<<template method>> #E2F0D9
 BorderColor<<template method>> #548235
 BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
 BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package \"stock.application (Frozen Spot)\" {

 class StockService {
 - stockRepository : StockRepository
 + create(input : CreateStockInput) : StockOutput
 + list() : List<StockOutput>
 + getById(id : Long) : StockOutput
 }

 class StockItemService <<template method>> {
 - stockRepository : StockRepository
 - stockItemRepository : StockItemRepository
 - stockLotRepository : StockLotRepository
 - stockMovementRepository : StockMovementRepository
 - productCompositionRepository : ProductCompositionRepository
 - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
 + create(stockId : Long, input : CreateStockItemInput) : StockItemOutput
 + listByStock(stockId : Long, input : ListStockItemsInput) : PagedResult<StockItemOutput>
 + listAll(active : Boolean) : List<StockItemOutput>
 + getById(id : Long) : StockItemOutput
 + listLots(stockItemId : Long) : List<StockLotOutput>
 + update(id : Long, input : UpdateStockItemInput) : StockItemOutput
 + delete(id : Long) : void
 + registerMovement(stockItemId : Long, input : RegisterMovementInput) : StockItemOutput
 + getBalance(stockItemId : Long) : int
 + deductStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
 + addStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
 }

 StockService -[hidden]right-> StockItemService
}

package \"stock.domain (Core & Hot Spot)\" {

 package \"repositories (ports)\" {
 interface StockRepository {
 + save(stock : Stock) : Stock
 + findById(id : StockId) : Optional<Stock>
 + findAll() : List<Stock>
 + delete(stock : Stock) : void
 }

 interface StockItemRepository {
 + save(stockItem : StockItem) : StockItem
 + findById(id : StockItemId) : Optional<StockItem>
 + findByIdForUpdate(id : StockItemId) : Optional<StockItem>
 + findByStockId(stockId : StockId, filter : StockItemFilter, page : PageQuery) : PagedResult<StockItem>
 + findAll(active : Boolean) : List<StockItem>
 + delete(stockItem : StockItem) : void
 }

 interface StockLotRepository {
 + save(stockLot : StockLot) : StockLot
 + findById(id : StockLotId) : Optional<StockLot>
 + findByStockItemIdForUpdate(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockLot>
 + findByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockLot>
 + delete(stockLot : StockLot) : void
 }

 interface StockMovementRepository {
 + save(stockMovement : StockMovement) : StockMovement
 + findById(id : StockMovementId) : Optional<StockMovement>
 + findByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockMovement>
 }

 interface ProductCompositionRepository {
 + deleteByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : void
 }
 }

 package \"model & hot spot\" {
 class Stock {
 - id : StockId
 - name : String
 }

 class StockItem {
 - id : StockItemId
 - stockId : StockId
 - name : String
 - category : String
 - unit : String
 - currentQuantity : int
 - minimumStock : int
 - unitCost : BigDecimal
 - active : boolean
 - deletedAt : LocalDateTime
 + isDeleted() : boolean
 + update(...) : StockItem
 + markDeleted() : StockItem
 + applyMovement(type : MovementType, quantity : int) : StockItem
 }

 class StockLot {
 - id : StockLotId
 - stockItemId : StockItemId
 - quantity : int
 - expiresAt : LocalDate
 - receivedAt : LocalDateTime
 + consume(amount : int) : StockLot
 + isEmpty() : boolean
 }

 class StockMovement {
 - id : StockMovementId
 - stockItemId : StockItemId
 - lotId : StockLotId
 - type : MovementType
 - quantity : int
 - occurredAt : LocalDateTime
 - reason : String
 }

 enum MovementType {
 ENTRADA
 SAIDA
 PERDA
 AJUSTE
 }

 interface LotAllocationStrategy <<hot spot>> {
 + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
 + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
 + getProductionLossFactor() : double
 }

 class LotAllocation <<record>> {
 + lotId : StockLotId
 + quantity : int
 }

 ' Árvore limpa sem cruzamento de linhas
 Stock \"1\" -right-> \"0..*\" StockItem : possui >
 StockItem \"1\" -down-> \"0..*\" StockLot : dividido em >
 StockItem \"1\" -down-> \"0..*\" StockMovement : histórico >
 StockLot \"0..1\" <-right- \"0..*\" StockMovement : refere-se a
 StockMovement -down-> MovementType

 StockLot <-down- LotAllocationStrategy : seleciona lotes (Strategy)
 LotAllocationStrategy -right-> LotAllocation : gera >
 }
}

package \"instances.stock (Especializações do Hot Spot 1)\" {

 class BurgerLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
 + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
 + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
 + getProductionLossFactor() : double
 --
 Regra: FEFO simples | Sem estorno EM_PREPARO | Perda = 0%
 }

 class PharmaLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
 + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
 + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
 + getProductionLossFactor() : double
 --
 Regra: FEFO (validade > +30d) + Lote Único | Perda = +5%
 }

 class PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
 + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
 + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
 + getProductionLossFactor() : double
 --
 Regra: FIFO (receivedAt) | Estorna 100% em bancada | Perda = 0%
 }

 BurgerLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy
 PharmaLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy
 PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy

 BurgerLotAllocationStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaLotAllocationStrategy
 PharmaLotAllocationStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy
}

' Relacionamentos da camada de Aplicação com os Repositórios
StockService -down-> StockRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockItemRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockLotRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockMovementRepository
StockItemService -down-> ProductCompositionRepository

' Posiciona o modelo de domínio abaixo dos repositórios sem cruzar setas
StockItemRepository -[hidden]down-> StockItem
StockLotRepository -[hidden]down-> StockLot
StockMovementRepository -[hidden]down-> StockMovement

g.data-meta-plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 80
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
    BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
    BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
    BackgroundColor<<template method>> #E2F0D9
    BorderColor<<template method>> #548235
    BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
    BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package "stock.application (Frozen Spot)" {

    class StockService {
        - stockRepository : StockRepository
        + create(input : CreateStockInput) : StockOutput
        + list() : List<StockOutput>
        + getById(id : Long) : StockOutput
    }

    class StockItemService <<template method>> {
        - stockRepository : StockRepository
        - stockItemRepository : StockItemRepository
        - stockLotRepository : StockLotRepository
        - stockMovementRepository : StockMovementRepository
        - productCompositionRepository : ProductCompositionRepository
        - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
        + create(stockId : Long, input : CreateStockItemInput) : StockItemOutput
        + listByStock(stockId : Long, input : ListStockItemsInput) : PagedResult<StockItemOutput>
        + listAll(active : Boolean) : List<StockItemOutput>
        + getById(id : Long) : StockItemOutput
        + listLots(stockItemId : Long) : List<StockLotOutput>
        + update(id : Long, input : UpdateStockItemInput) : StockItemOutput
        + delete(id : Long) : void
        + registerMovement(stockItemId : Long, input : RegisterMovementInput) : StockItemOutput
        + getBalance(stockItemId : Long) : int
        + deductStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
        + addStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
    }

    StockService -[hidden]right-> StockItemService
}

package "stock.domain (Core & Hot Spot)" {

    package "repositories (ports)" {
        interface StockRepository {
            + save(stock : Stock) : Stock
            + findById(id : StockId) : Optional<Stock>
            + findAll() : List<Stock>
            + delete(stock : Stock) : void
        }

        interface StockItemRepository {
            + save(stockItem : StockItem) : StockItem
            + findById(id : StockItemId) : Optional<StockItem>
            + findByIdForUpdate(id : StockItemId) : Optional<StockItem>
            + findByStockId(stockId : StockId, filter : StockItemFilter, page : PageQuery) : PagedResult<StockItem>
            + findAll(active : Boolean) : List<StockItem>
            + delete(stockItem : StockItem) : void
        }

        interface StockLotRepository {
            + save(stockLot : StockLot) : StockLot
            + findById(id : StockLotId) : Optional<StockLot>
            + findByStockItemIdForUpdate(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockLot>
            + findByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockLot>
            + delete(stockLot : StockLot) : void
        }

        interface StockMovementRepository {
            + save(stockMovement : StockMovement) : StockMovement
            + findById(id : StockMovementId) : Optional<StockMovement>
            + findByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : List<StockMovement>
        }

        interface ProductCompositionRepository {
            + deleteByStockItemId(stockItemId : StockItemId) : void
        }
    }

    package "model & hot spot" {
        class Stock {
            - id : StockId
            - name : String
        }

        class StockItem {
            - id : StockItemId
            - stockId : StockId
            - name : String
            - category : String
            - unit : String
            - currentQuantity : int
            - minimumStock : int
            - unitCost : BigDecimal
            - active : boolean
            - deletedAt : LocalDateTime
            + isDeleted() : boolean
            + update(...) : StockItem
            + markDeleted() : StockItem
            + applyMovement(type : MovementType, quantity : int) : StockItem
        }

        class StockLot {
            - id : StockLotId
            - stockItemId : StockItemId
            - quantity : int
            - expiresAt : LocalDate
            - receivedAt : LocalDateTime
            + consume(amount : int) : StockLot
            + isEmpty() : boolean
        }

        class StockMovement {
            - id : StockMovementId
            - stockItemId : StockItemId
            - lotId : StockLotId
            - type : MovementType
            - quantity : int
            - occurredAt : LocalDateTime
            - reason : String
        }

        enum MovementType {
            ENTRADA
            SAIDA
            PERDA
            AJUSTE
        }

        interface LotAllocationStrategy <<hot spot>> {
            + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
            + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
            + getProductionLossFactor() : double
        }

        class LotAllocation <<record>> {
            + lotId : StockLotId
            + quantity : int
        }

        ' Árvore limpa sem cruzamento de linhas
        Stock "1" -right-> "0..*" StockItem : possui >
        StockItem "1" -down-> "0..*" StockLot : dividido em >
        StockItem "1" -down-> "0..*" StockMovement : histórico >
        StockLot "0..1" <-right- "0..*" StockMovement : refere-se a
        StockMovement -down-> MovementType

        StockLot <-down- LotAllocationStrategy : seleciona lotes (Strategy)
        LotAllocationStrategy -right-> LotAllocation : gera >
    }
}

package "instances.stock (Especializações do Hot Spot 1)" {

    class BurgerLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
        + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
        + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
        + getProductionLossFactor() : double
        --
        Regra: FEFO simples | Sem estorno EM_PREPARO | Perda = 0%
    }

    class PharmaLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
        + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
        + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
        + getProductionLossFactor() : double
        --
        Regra: FEFO (validade > +30d) + Lote Único | Perda = +5%
    }

    class PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy <<instance>> {
        + allocate(availableLots : List<StockLot>, requiredQuantity : int) : List<LotAllocation>
        + shouldRestoreOnCancellation(currentStatus : SaleStatus) : boolean
        + getProductionLossFactor() : double
        --
        Regra: FIFO (receivedAt) | Estorna 100% em bancada | Perda = 0%
    }

    BurgerLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy
    PharmaLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy
    PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy -up.|> LotAllocationStrategy

    BurgerLotAllocationStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaLotAllocationStrategy
    PharmaLotAllocationStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderLotAllocationStrategy
}

' Relacionamentos da camada de Aplicação com os Repositórios
StockService -down-> StockRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockItemRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockLotRepository
StockItemService -down-> StockMovementRepository
StockItemService -down-> ProductCompositionRepository

' Posiciona o modelo de domínio abaixo dos repositórios sem cruzar setas
StockItemRepository -[hidden]down-> StockItem
StockLotRepository -[hidden]down-> StockLot
StockMovementRepository -[hidden]down-> StockMovement

@enduml
",
  "config": null
}
